question: 深圳市目前收录了多少个岗位？平均月薪是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS job_count, ROUND(AVG(salary_avg), 1) AS avg_salary_k FROM job_intel WHERE city = '深圳' AND salary_avg IS NOT NULL

question: 列出平均月薪最高的前 5 个岗位名称、公司、城市和平均月薪
reference_sql: SELECT title, company, city, salary_avg FROM job_intel WHERE salary_avg IS NOT NULL ORDER BY salary_avg DESC, id ASC LIMIT 5

question: 对比深圳、广州、东莞三城的岗位数量和平均月薪

question: 按经验要求分组统计各阶段岗位的数量和平均月薪

question: 按学历要求分组统计岗位数量和平均月薪

question: 统计各岗位大类的岗位数量及其占全部岗位的百分比
reference_sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS job_count, ROUND(COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM job_intel), 1) AS pct FROM job_intel WHERE category != '' GROUP BY category ORDER BY job_count DESC

question: 统计深圳、广州、东莞各城市应届生友好岗位的数量及占比
reference_sql: SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total_jobs, SUM(CASE WHEN fresh_grad_friendly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fresh_friendly_jobs, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN fresh_grad_friendly = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) AS fresh_friendly_pct FROM job_intel GROUP BY city ORDER BY fresh_friendly_pct DESC

question: 按所属行业分组统计岗位数量和平均月薪，按均薪降序排列

question: 按企业规模分组统计岗位数量和平均月薪

question: 统计深圳各行政区的岗位数量，列出排名前 5 的行政区
reference_sql: SELECT district, COUNT(*) AS job_count FROM job_intel WHERE city = '深圳' AND district != '' GROUP BY district ORDER BY job_count DESC LIMIT 5

question: 统计被提及次数排名前 10 的技能及其岗位数量
reference_sql: SELECT js.skill, COUNT(DISTINCT js.job_id) AS job_count FROM job_skills js GROUP BY js.skill ORDER BY job_count DESC, js.skill ASC LIMIT 10

question: 广州不限经验且要求 RAG 技能的岗位有多少个？平均月薪是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) AS job_count, ROUND(AVG(j.salary_avg), 1) AS avg_salary_k FROM job_intel j JOIN job_skills js ON j.id = js.job_id WHERE j.city = '广州' AND j.experience = '经验不限' AND js.skill = 'RAG' AND j.salary_avg IS NOT NULL

question: 同时要求 Python 和 LangGraph 两项技能的岗位有多少个？平均月薪是多少？
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS job_count, ROUND(AVG(salary_avg), 1) AS avg_salary_k FROM job_intel WHERE salary_avg IS NOT NULL AND id IN (SELECT js.job_id FROM job_skills js WHERE js.skill IN ('Python', 'LangGraph') GROUP BY js.job_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT js.skill) = 2)

question: 统计要求 RAG 技能的岗位在深圳、广州、东莞三城的岗位数量与平均月薪
reference_sql: SELECT j.city, COUNT(DISTINCT j.id) AS job_count, ROUND(AVG(j.salary_avg), 1) AS avg_salary_k FROM job_intel j JOIN job_skills js ON j.id = js.job_id WHERE js.skill = 'RAG' AND j.salary_avg IS NOT NULL GROUP BY j.city ORDER BY avg_salary_k DESC

question: 要求 Function Calling 技能且对应届生友好的岗位有多少个？

question: 统计各个岗位大类中明确要求 LLM 技能的岗位数量

question: 要求 CUDA 技能的岗位有多少个？最高月薪和平均月薪分别是多少？
